subject: website
name: AirSwap
summary: AirSwap's web app, open source (MIT). It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics, and fonts from Adobe Typekit. Trades settle on chain, but the app reads through hosted endpoints and makers' own servers.

connections.name: Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, without asking.

connections.name: Adobe Typekit fonts (use.typekit.net)
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Adobe the visit.
